stories.title: Four arrested after fatal stabbing at Shriram Chowk, Kalindi Kunj, police say
stories.body: Delhi Police have arrested four men in connection with the fatal stabbing of a 23-year-old man at Shriram Chowk in Kalindi Kunj on Wednesday 14 October, PTI reported on Thursday 15 October. A police officer said the motive was an old rivalry dating to a 2025 altercation inside Tihar Jail and that the attack was planned. According to the report, four men on a motorcycle intercepted the man on his way back from Basantpur and stabbed him before fleeing; police found an abandoned scooter with bloodstains at the spot. Police are looking for the remaining suspects and trying to recover the weapons used.
stories.check: The number of arrests differs between reports: PTI (15 Oct, evening) says four, while The Statesman (15 Oct, earlier in the day) says three. Confirm the current figure with Delhi Police. The case is under investigation; the motive is the police's account only.

stories.title: BSES lists one-hour power cut in Jamia Nagar on Saturday 17 October
stories.body: BSES Rajdhani's maintenance schedule for Saturday 17 October lists a power cut in Jamia Nagar, Okhla, from 11 am to 12 noon for preventive maintenance of a transformer, according to a Times Now Hindi listing published on Friday 16 October. The listing places the entry under the New Friends Colony division. It names no other locality covered by this brief for that day. Schedules can change at short notice, and the listing does not say which lanes or blocks of Jamia Nagar are affected.
stories.check: Single secondary source (a news listing of the BSES schedule). Confirm the timing and the affected lanes on the BSES app or helpline.

stories.title: Jamia Vice-Chancellor and Registrar hold day-long dialogue with Subject Association office bearers
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia's Vice-Chancellor Prof. Mazhar Asif and Registrar Prof. Md. Mahtab Alam Rizvi held a day-long dialogue with elected office bearers of the Subject Associations of all departments and centres, according to a university press release dated Friday 16 October. The release says the session ran for more than six hours and gave students a forum to raise concerns. Suggestions included stronger industry-academia links, better placement initiatives and institutionalised student exchange programmes. The Vice-Chancellor said issues would be sorted into short-term ones to be resolved immediately and long-term ones to be addressed as funds allow. Nodal officers have been appointed for SWAYAM courses, the Indian Knowledge System, NEP 2020 implementation and internships, the release says.
stories.check: Single source (Jamia press release 6160). The release page shows only the headline; the details come from the English PDF, which does not state the date or venue of the meeting. Confirm with Jamia.

stories.title: Jamia's Premchand Archives holds two-day workshop on archival preservation and digitisation
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia's Premchand Archives and Literary Centre held a two-day workshop on archival preservation, digitisation and metadata creation on Tuesday 13 and Wednesday 14 October, according to a university press release dated Friday 16 October. The release says it was part of the Endangered Archives Programme, funded by the British Library and Arcadia, which aims to digitise material dating before 1950 related to Jamia's founding and its literary holdings. Sessions combined presentations and hands-on exercises. Participants were teachers and students of the PG Diploma in Photography and Visual Communication at the AJK Mass Communication Research Centre.
stories.check: Single source (Jamia press release 6159). The release page shows only the headline; the workshop dates come from the English PDF. Confirm with Jamia.

stories.title: Jamia's Department of Foreign Languages hosts talk on Italian culture and everyday life
stories.body: The Department of Foreign Languages at Jamia Millia Islamia organised a talk titled "Italy: Culture, Traditions and Everyday Life" at Ho Chi Minh Hall on Tuesday 13 October, according to a university press release dated Friday 16 October. The main speaker was Dr. Michele Tantardini of Penn State Harrisburg, USA. The release says he spoke about Italy's regional differences in history, cuisine and dialects, and briefly introduced Dante Alighieri's Divina Commedia. The session was coordinated by Dr. Rohit Bajaj and was interactive, with students asking questions about everyday life in Italy.
stories.check: Single source (Jamia press release 6157). The release page shows only the headline; the event date and venue come from the English PDF. Confirm with Jamia.

stories.title: Jamia lists lecture by Nicaragua's Ambassador; release text carries a September date
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia lists a press release on a special lecture by Nadeska Imara Cuthbert Carlson, Ambassador of Nicaragua to India, titled "A window into Nicaragua: Culture, Literature & Traditions". The release says it was organised by the Spanish and Latin American Studies programme of the Department of Foreign Languages with the Embassy of Nicaragua, and covered the country's history, culture, languages, cuisine and festivals. It says the ambassador presented the university with a portrait of the poet Rubén Darío. The university's listing places the release in the week of 16 October, but the text of the PDF gives 22 September as the date.
stories.check: NEEDS CHECK: the Jamia listing dates this release to 16 October (file name 2026October16), but the English PDF text is dated 22 September 2026. Confirm with Jamia when the lecture took place before publishing.

stories.title: Jamia's Controller of Examinations office takes part in Swachhata Hi Seva cleanliness drive
stories.body: A Swachhata Hi Seva cleanliness drive was held at the Office of the Controller of Examinations at Jamia Millia Islamia, according to a university press release dated Thursday 15 October. The release says Controller of Examinations Prof. Ahteshamul Haque led by example by sweeping the area around the office building, and that staff joined in. It says the drive cleaned the office surroundings and promoted a clean, green and sustainable workplace, and that the Vice-Chancellor and Registrar provided guidance. The release does not give the date of the drive.
stories.check: Single source (Jamia press release 6156). The event date is not stated. Confirm with Jamia.
